## About
D and K Collision Repair Center is a family owned auto body shop on Woodland Avenue in San Rafael. Our goal is high quality repairs on a timely basis, with transparent pricing and as little hassle as possible.
From the first look at your car to the day you pick up your keys, we keep you in the loop with text and email messages, so you always know where your repair stands.
Customers have given us a 5 star rating across 61 Google reviews. One reviewer mentioned Francisco and his sons by name, and Roberto gets a thank you in our reviews as well.

## Services
- Collision repair, dent removal and painting: Body work after an accident, from taking out dents to refinishing the paint.
- Auto glass replacement: Damaged vehicle glass taken out and replaced so you can see clearly and drive safely.
- Frame straightening: Getting your car's frame back where it belongs after a hard hit.
- Insurance claims: We guide you through the claim, talk with your provider and make sure repairs are documented the way they require.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. We work with all major insurance companies to help the repair process go smoothly.

Q: How long will my repair take?
A: It depends on how much damage there is, the repairs needed and parts availability. We send you updates while your car is with us.

Q: How much will my repair cost?
A: Cost depends on the damage, the parts and materials, and the labor involved. We always give you transparent pricing information.

Q: Do you offer a warranty on your repairs?
A: Yes. Our workmanship is covered for as long as you own the vehicle, and parts carry the manufacturer's warranty. If something isn't right, bring the car back and we'll make it right.
